cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: broad selling, 28% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.25% · WTI -0.11% · Brent -1.57% · NatGas -0.89%. At the last close, 28% of 68 energy names were green — broad selling. Refining & Downstream did the heavy lifting at +1.92%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +1.92%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -5.85%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: LEU is the standout at -9.75%
cards.body: Leaders: SLB +4.22%, DINO +2.79%, WFRD +1.98%, HAL +1.94%, PSX +1.75%. Laggards: LEU -9.75%, UEC -8.96%, NXE -7.06%, UUUU -6.80%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
